neighbours.label: study-design adjectives such as ' prospective', ' randomized', ' retrospective', ' observational'
fire: The team enrolled 400 adults in a prospective study of sleep and memory.
Results from a large randomized trial were published last spring.
Our hospital ran a retrospective review of all knee surgeries since 2010.
Data came from an observational cohort of nurses followed for decades.
The authors pooled twelve prospective cohorts from three continents.
Patients were assigned in a randomized fashion to either drug or placebo.
A retrospective analysis found no link between the vaccine and seizures.
Most evidence so far comes from observational data rather than trials.
quiet: The team enrolled 400 adults in a large study of sleep and memory.
Results from a big national survey were published last spring.
Our hospital ran a careful review of all knee surgeries since 2010.
Data came from a long cohort of nurses followed for decades.
The authors pooled twelve separate cohorts from three continents.
Patients were assigned by their doctors to either drug or placebo.
A recent analysis found no link between the vaccine and seizures.
Most evidence so far comes from laboratory data rather than people.

notes: Card: ' prospective' x10, ' randomized' x6 of the top 32; L0 so tested as tokens.
